5959: Medulloblastoma is missing from this split. PanelApp Australia curates ELP1 for paediatric medulloblastoma of the sonic hedgehog subtype, monoallelic: Green on the Medulloblastoma and Cancer Predisposition_Paediatric panels, and listed on the Mendeliome entry. These reports leave out diseases in which cancer predisposition is the primary phenotype, so the two medulloblastoma papers among this gene's papers (PMID 32296180 and PMID 39184053) were read but not assessed, and no association was made. A complete split of ELP1 needs a third association for medulloblastoma.
